applies_to: DTA116A51 adaptor with up to 16 VRV indoor units (D-NET 1-00 to 1-15), per functional specification CB13A033 first edition.
summary: The DTA116A51 connects a Daikin VRV system's D-III NET bus to a Modbus RTU master. Input registers report adaptor readiness, which indoor units are connected, each unit's capabilities, on/off, mode, setpoint, room temperature and error state; holding registers send on/off, mode, fan and setpoint commands. Most per-unit registers pack several small fields into one word, so this map gives the single-bit flags directly and describes the multi-bit fields.

addressing.note: The spec lists 30001/40001-style registers and states that the request addresses them from zero (30001 is sent as 0, 40001 as 0). Its example frames confirm it: register 31001 is requested as 0x03E8 and 42002 as 0x07D1.

source.title: Functional Specifications D-NET/Modbus Communication adaptor DTA116A51
source.pages: pp. 3-8 (settings, frames, timing), pp. 11-14 (register lists), pp. 15-27 (register bit layouts), p. 31+ (error codes)

notes: Daikin does not appear to host this specification publicly; the link is the unaltered Daikin Industries document as mirrored by the integrator TapHome.
Per-unit blocks repeat: capabilities every 3 registers from 31001, status every 6 from 32001, control every 3 from 42001, for D-NET addresses 1-00 to 1-15.

Packed fields (from the spec's bit diagrams): capability word bits 8-10 fan direction level (1 fix, 2-5 = 2-5 step), bit 11 fan direction available, bits 12-14 fan volume steps (1 fix, 2 two-step, 3 three-step), bit 15 fan volume available. Status 1 bits 8-10 fan direction (0-4 = P0-P4, 7 = swing), bits 12-14 fan volume (1 L, 3 M, 5 H). Status 2 bits 0-3 operation mode, 4-7 filter sign (0 off, 1-15 on), 8-11 actual operation (0 fan, 1 heat, 2 cool), 14-15 cool/heat master (0 undecided, 1 slave, 2 master).

Control 1 (42001+3n): bit 0 on/off, bits 4-7 fan control flag that must be 6, bits 8-10 fan direction (0-4 P0-P4, 6 stop, 7 swing), bits 12-14 fan volume (1 L, 3 M, 5 H; 0 if the unit has no fan volume capability). Control 2: bits 0-3 mode (0 fan, 1 heat, 2 cool, 3 auto, 6 setpoint, 7 dry), bits 4-7 filter sign reset (15 = reset, then write 0 again), bits 8-11 heat/cool setpoint selection in auto (1 heat, 2 cool).
Setpoint limit registers hold two signed 8-bit values (°C) in one word; they are listed as UINT16 because the schema has no 8-bit type.
Left out: the error code mapping table (section 6), which converts the two mapping values into Daikin error codes.

integration.summary: Wait for 30001 = 1, read 30002 to see which indoor units exist, then poll each unit's six status registers from 32001 with function 04 (up to 32 registers per read). Before commanding a unit, copy its current state into its three holding registers; the adaptor sends a command whenever a holding register value changes.
integration.enable: Set the Modbus slave address (1-15, 0 = Modbus off) on DIP switch DS2 and baud, stop bits and parity on DS1. Holding register 40001 sets whether the adaptor is D-NET master; set it to slave (bit 8 = 0) when another central controller is on the VRV system.
quirks: Function 03 is not supported: read input registers with 04, write holding registers with 06 or 16 (up to 30 registers).
Reads are limited to 32 registers per request.
Holding registers are not refreshed from the units; if they are not kept in step with the input registers, a command can be skipped or undo a change made at a remote controller.
setup: DS1-2: 9600 (off) or 19200 (on) baud. DS1-3 off = 1 stop bit with parity, on = 2 stop bits, no parity. DS1-4 parity even (off) or odd (on).
Leave a silent interval (5 ms at 9600, 2.5 ms at 19200) plus 20 ms between a reply and the next query.
gotchas: Daikin limits commands to about 7,000 per indoor unit per year; avoid writing values that did not change.
With an RQCEQ-PY1 outdoor unit, synchronise the operation mode register with the unit's actual mode before writing a setpoint.
